name: vellum-studio
description: Illustration workspace with session presence tools.

scripts.build:icon: mkdir -p native/Icon/dist && swiftc -O -swift-version 5 -target arm64-apple-macos13.0 -framework AppKit -o native/Icon/dist/make-icon native/Icon/make-icon.swift && ./native/Icon/dist/make-icon build/icon.iconset && iconutil -c icns build/icon.iconset -o build/icon.icns
scripts.build: npm run build:native && npm run build:icon && npm run build:renderer
scripts.dist: npm run build:native:universal && npm run build:icon && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --mac
scripts.staple: xcrun stapler staple dist/*.dmg && xcrun stapler validate dist/*.dmg
